title: Ashes on the Waterfront
art_style: Print Comic Noir Style (halftones, bold outlines, high-contrast lighting, rain-slicked urban decay, dynamic fractured paneling)
short_summary: Detective Jack investigates a murder in a rain-soaked city, uncovering secrets in the shadows of the waterfront. Each clue draws him deeper into a web of violence and memory.
world_context: A mid-20th-century American city, perpetually rain-soaked, with crumbling warehouses, neon-lit streets, and a sense of urban decay. The city is gritty, dangerous, and alive with secrets.

characters.name: Jack
characters.physical_traits: Tall, lean, weathered face, stubble, sharp blue eyes, often shadowed by a battered fedora. Limp in left leg.
characters.typical_attire: Rain-soaked trenchcoat, dark suit, battered fedora, scuffed shoes.
characters.backstory: A former beat cop turned private investigator, haunted by unsolved cases and a failed marriage. Jack is driven by guilt and a stubborn sense of justice.
characters.motivations: To find the truth behind Eddie's murder, redeem himself for past failures, and survive the city's darkness.

characters.name: Eddie
characters.physical_traits: Short, wiry, ink-stained fingers, thinning hair, nervous eyes.
characters.typical_attire: Work shirt, suspenders, cheap slacks, battered shoes.
characters.backstory: A dockworker and part-time bookkeeper, Eddie got in over his head with the wrong people. He kept secrets in ledgers and trusted the wrong friends.
characters.motivations: Wanted to escape the city with enough money to start over.

characters.name: Vagrant
characters.physical_traits: Gaunt, unshaven, missing teeth, watery eyes, bundled in layers of mismatched clothing.
characters.typical_attire: Tattered coat, fingerless gloves, wool cap.
characters.backstory: Once a dockworker himself, now homeless after a workplace accident. Survives by scavenging and keeping his ears open.
characters.motivations: Wants warmth, food, and to be left alone. Sells information for coins.

chapters.chapter_summary: Jack investigates a murder scene in a derelict waterfront warehouse. He finds Eddie's body and several clues, then interviews a vagrant who witnessed part of the crime. The chapter ends with Jack leaving the scene, the city closing in.

scenes.scene_description: Jack arrives at the rain-soaked, decaying warehouse on the waterfront.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Establishing shot of a rusted tin warehouse squatting on the waterfront, battered by relentless rain. Broken glass glints in the windows, and the dock is slick with puddles. Sodium streetlights cast harsh yellow pools on the wet concrete. The city skyline looms in the background, shrouded in mist. Portrait 4:5.

dialogue.text: Rain. The warehouse loomed in darkness.

panels.color_palette: desaturated blues, grays, harsh yellow highlights

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Medium shot of a man in a rain-soaked trenchcoat and battered fedora (Jack) standing in the warehouse doorway, shoulders hunched against the downpour. Water drips from his hat brim, and his face is shadowed, eyes sharp. The heavy door creaks open behind him. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack enters the warehouse, bracing against the rain.

dialogue.text: Salt, diesel, and old blood hung in the air.

panels.color_palette: muted grays, blue-black shadows, pale skin tones

pages.page_description: Establishes the rain-soaked, decaying warehouse and Jack's arrival.

scenes.scene_description: Jack moves through the shadows inside the warehouse, senses alert to the sounds and smells.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Wide shot of the warehouse interior: stacks of crates, broken glass, puddles reflecting the ceiling's flickering light. Jack moves cautiously through deep shadows, trenchcoat heavy and dripping. Steam rises from a nearby grate. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack moves through the warehouse, alert to every sound.

dialogue.text: Each step echoed with memories of old crime scenes.

panels.color_palette: cold blues, gray shadows, muted browns

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Medium shot from a low angle: Jack's boots splash through a puddle, water rippling outward. The leaking pipe overhead drips steadily, and a faint red stain is visible on the concrete. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack steps through puddles, senses heightened.
panels.color_palette: steel gray, muted reds, blue highlights

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Close-up of Jack's face, nostrils flaring as he reacts to the stench. Rainwater drips from his hat brim, and the background is blurred with crates and shadows. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack reacts to the smell of rot and wet cardboard.

dialogue.text: Rot. Wet cardboard. The city’s secrets never washed away.

pages.page_description: Jack moves through the warehouse, senses alert to sound and smell.

scenes.scene_description: Jack discovers Eddie's body and examines the evidence around him.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Wide shot from above: Eddie's body lies crumpled near a stack of crates, blood pooling on the concrete and mingling with city grime. Jack stands nearby, casting a long shadow. The baseball card and torn ledger page are visible beside the body. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack discovers Eddie's body and surveys the scene.
panels.color_palette: muted reds, gray concrete, faded browns

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Close-up of Eddie's ink-stained hands clutching a torn ledger page, numbers smeared with blood. The baseball card, edges soft and stained, lies just beside his fingers. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Focus on evidence in Eddie's hands.
panels.color_palette: faded reds, yellowed paper, blue ink

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Medium shot: Jack kneels beside the body, examining the evidence. His gloved hand hovers over a cigarette butt with lipstick on the filter, and glove fibers are caught on a crate edge. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack examines clues around the body.

dialogue.text: A lipstick-stained cigarette. Glove fibers. The chain begins.

pages.page_description: Jack discovers Eddie's body and examines the evidence.

scenes.scene_description: A vagrant emerges from the shadows and shares what he heard and saw.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Medium shot: A gaunt vagrant, bundled in mismatched layers, emerges from behind a stack of crates. His face is shadowed, eyes wary. Jack stands in the foreground, half-turned, hand near his pocket. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Vagrant steps out of the shadows, catching Jack's attention.

dialogue.text: Heard singin’. Opera. Man left after. Didn’t see his face, but he whistled all the way out.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Close-up of Jack's hand pressing coins into the vagrant's dirty palm. The vagrant's fingers tremble, and the coins glint in the dim light. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack pays the vagrant for information.

pages.page_description: Jack questions the vagrant, who shares what he heard and saw.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Close-up of the vagrant's face, eyes wide and earnest, mouth open as he answers. The background is a blur of crates and darkness. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Vagrant describes the gloves he saw.

dialogue.text: Black. Shiny. Like the kind the butcher wears.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Medium shot: Jack stands, silhouetted against the warehouse exit, as the vagrant fades into the shadows behind him. Rain streaks the open doorway. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack prepares to leave, the vagrant recedes into darkness.

dialogue.text: The city pressed in, tighter than ever.

pages.page_description: Vagrant describes the gloves; Jack prepares to leave.

scenes.scene_description: Jack leaves an anonymous call for the police and limps away into the night.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Medium shot: Jack stands at a payphone outside the warehouse, rain streaking the glass. His face is obscured, hand cupped around the receiver. The city lights blur in the background. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack makes an anonymous call to the police.

dialogue.text: There’s a body at the old warehouse. Waterfront. You’ll want to hurry.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Wide shot: Jack limps away from the warehouse, his silhouette small against the rain-slicked street. The city looms, neon signs flickering, and the night seems to close in around him. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack limps into the night, swallowed by the city.

dialogue.text: He limped into the night. The city swallowed him whole.

pages.page_description: Jack calls the police and leaves the scene, the city closing in.
